objectives.en: Say every fact from eleven times one to eleven times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti eleven times one dé eleven times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from eleven times one reach eleven times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any eleven times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí eleven times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any eleven times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.note: NERDC's primary ceiling is 9 x 9; no class requires this table. Kept as enrichment after Primary 3.

say.en: Look at three groups of eleven mangoes. Today we count in elevens.
say.pcm: Look three groups of eleven mango. Today we go count eleven eleven.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti eleven mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní eleven eleven.

say.en: Today you will learn the eleven times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table eleven. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table eleven. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the ten times table? What is ten times four?
say.pcm: You remember table ten? Ten times four na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table ten? Kí ni ten times four?

say.en: Three groups of eleven mangoes show this. We count eleven, twenty-two, thirty-three. Eleven times three is thirty-three.
say.pcm: See three groups of eleven mango: eleven, twenty-two, thirty-three. Eleven times three na thirty-three.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti eleven mango: eleven, twenty-two, thirty-three. Eleven times three jẹ́ thirty-three.

say.en: Say it with me: eleven times three is thirty-three.
say.pcm: Say am with me: eleven times three na thirty-three.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: eleven times three jẹ́ thirty-three.

say.en: Say the eleven times table. Start with eleven times one. End with eleven times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table eleven. Start with eleven times one. End with eleven times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table eleven. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú eleven times one. Parí pẹ̀lú eleven times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Eleven times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the eleven times table once more. Then we start the twelve times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table eleven again. Then we start table twelve.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table eleven. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table twelve.
